components.name: tta-smarthub-((env))
components.description: TTA Hub web and worker application. The subject of this repository's build and deploy pipeline.

authorization.note: Worker process authorized separately by ADR 0013.

components.name: clamav-api-ttahub-((env))
components.description: Internal ClamAV scanning API. Reached by the worker over an internal route, never bound as a service.

authorization.note: Also shown as the file scanning API container in docs/boundary_diagram.md.

components.notes: Not declared in manifest.yml and invisible to release-manifest.json before ADR 0029. Reached through CLAMAV_ENDPOINT in deployment_config.

components.name: tta-similarity-api-((env))
components.description: Python similarity API used to identify duplicate goals. Currently stopped in production.

authorization.note: Shown as the Similarity API container in docs/boundary_diagram.md.

components.notes: Stopped but still bound to the production database service. See disposition INV-2026-0001.

components.name: tta-automation
components.description: Automation application for production backup, PII removal, and restore into lower environment databases. Stopped unless a task is running.

authorization.note: Automation boundary. The diagram records that at most one configuration is enabled at a time, connections are unbound when not in use, and no routes are configured.

components.notes: The diagram states no routes are configured for this application, but an unattached route exists. See disposition INV-2026-0003.

components.name: tta-smarthub-maintenance-page-((env))
components.description: Static page served in place of the TTA Hub during incident response or blocking maintenance. The primary hostname is remapped to this application so users cannot reach the live site while work is in progress.

authorization.note: Maintenance Page container in the Application boundary. Added by TTAHUB-5245; the diagram change requires SSPO approval, tracked by disposition INV-2026-0002.

components.notes: Runs continuously so the primary hostname can be remapped without a deploy. Route destinations are recorded but not reconciled, precisely so a maintenance remap does not read as drift.

components.name: tta-smarthub-((env)):web
components.description: Express API and React single page application. Three instances in production.

components.name: tta-smarthub-((env)):worker
components.description: Bull queue worker for background processing. Two instances in production. Only instance 0 runs cron jobs.

components.name: ttahub-((env))
components.description: Primary PostgreSQL database holding TTA Hub content and configuration.

authorization.note: Read replica plan authorized by ADR 0016.

components.notes: Also bound to tta-similarity-api-((env)). See disposition INV-2026-0001.

components.name: ttahub-redis-((env))
components.description: Redis instance backing the Bull job queues and session store.

components.name: ttahub-document-upload-((env))
components.description: S3 bucket storing user uploaded file attachments.

authorization.note: AWS S3 bucket container storing static file assets.

components.name: ttahub-process
components.description: PostgreSQL database used to process production data and remove PII before restore into lower environments.

authorization.note: Automation PostgreSQL Database container.

components.name: ttahub-db-backups
components.description: S3 bucket storing encrypted production and processed database backups.

authorization.note: Automation AWS S3 bucket container.

components.name: ttahub-log-transfer
components.description: S3 bucket receiving production database logs when requested from cloud.gov.

authorization.note: Log transfer AWS S3 bucket container.

components.name: ttahub-staging
components.description: Staging PostgreSQL database. Resides in the production space so the automation application can restore PII free data into it.

authorization.note: Services - Staging boundary, restore target of the automation application.

components.name: ttahub-dev-blue
components.description: Dev blue PostgreSQL database. Restore target of the automation application.

authorization.note: Services - Dev boundary.

components.name: ttahub-dev-gold
components.description: Dev gold PostgreSQL database. Restore target of the automation application.

authorization.note: Services - Dev boundary.

components.name: ttahub-dev-green
components.description: Dev green PostgreSQL database. Restore target of the automation application.

authorization.note: Services - Dev boundary.

components.name: ttahub-dev-pink
components.description: Dev pink PostgreSQL database. Restore target of the automation application.

authorization.note: Services - Dev boundary.

components.name: ttahub-dev-red
components.description: Dev red PostgreSQL database. Restore target of the automation application.

authorization.note: Services - Dev boundary.

components.name: domain-((env))
components.description: External domain service providing the custom production hostname and its certificate.

authorization.note: Backs TTA_SMART_HUB_URI, https://ttahub.ohs.acf.hhs.gov.

components.name: ((env))-app-deployer
components.description: Cloud.gov space deployer service account used by CircleCI to authenticate and push the application.

authorization.note: Credentials supplied to the deploy job through CLOUDGOV_PROD_USERNAME and the matching password.

components.name: ttahub.ohs.acf.hhs.gov
components.description: Primary production hostname serving end users.

authorization.note: Declared as TTA_SMART_HUB_URI and REDIRECT_URI_HOST.

components.name: tta-smarthub-((env))1.app.cloud.gov
components.description: Platform hostname currently mapped to the application.

authorization.note: app_url in prod_vars.yml records tta-smarthub-prod.app.cloud.gov, which is not the mapped route. See disposition INV-2026-0004.

components.name: clamapi-ttahub-((env)).apps.internal
components.description: Internal route the worker uses to reach the ClamAV scanning API. Not reachable from outside the platform.

authorization.note: Declared as CLAMAV_ENDPOINT. Authorized by ADR 0012.

components.name: tta-smarthub-maintenance-page-((env)).app.cloud.gov
components.description: Route serving the maintenance page application.

authorization.note: Inherits the authorization of the application it serves.

components.name: tta-similarity-api-((env)).app.cloud.gov
components.description: Route mapped to the similarity API application.

components.name: cflinuxfs4
components.description: Cloud Foundry root filesystem the application runs on.

components.name: nodejs-buildpack
components.description: Node.js buildpack that stages the application.

authorization.note: manifest.yml references https://github.com/cloudfoundry/nodejs-buildpack.git with no tag or commit, so the staged version can change without a repository change.

components.notes: Known gap recorded by ADR 0029. The declared value is the version cloud.gov reported for the current droplet, not a pinned source reference. See disposition INV-2026-0005.

components.name: .nvmrc
components.description: Node runtime version pinned for local development, CI, and buildpack detection.

components.name: Dockerfile
components.description: Base image used for local development and CI containers.

components.name: manifest.yml
components.description: Cloud Foundry application manifest declaring the deployed shape.

components.name: deployment_config/prod_vars.yml
components.description: Production environment variable values supplied to cf push.

components.name: deployment_config/staging_vars.yml
components.description: Staging environment variable values.

components.name: deployment_config/dev_vars.yml
components.description: Dev environment variable values, shared by every dev colour environment.

components.name: deployment_config/sandbox_vars.yml
components.description: Sandbox environment variable values.

components.name: yarn.lock
components.description: Authoritative resolved dependency set for the backend and worker. Individual packages are not declared; the lockfile is the boundary.

authorization.note: Vulnerability disposition for these packages is owned by ADR 0027.

components.name: frontend/yarn.lock
components.description: Authoritative resolved dependency set for the frontend.

authorization.note: Vulnerability disposition for these packages is owned by ADR 0027.

components.name: TTA Hub Project Management Plan
components.description: Approved PMP. The configuration management owner confirmed this document includes the CM Plan and is the only programmatic CI in scope for TTAHUB-5246.

authorization.note: The CM owner, confirmed the PMP includes the CM Plan and is the only programmatic CI in scope for TTAHUB-5246.

components.name: HSES authentication
components.description: OIDC single sign on with authorization code and PKCE, client authentication by private key JWT.

components.name: HSES recipient data
components.description: Source of grantee and recipient data retrieved over HTTPS.

components.name: ITAMS SFTP
components.description: SFTP source for monitoring and CLASS data files.

components.name: AWS SES SMTP
components.description: Outbound email delivery for user notifications, with bounce and complaint handling through SNS.

components.name: New Relic
components.description: Application performance monitoring, log forwarding, and health check alerting.

components.name: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics
components.description: Web analytics tagging. Sends non PII traffic data only.

components.name: Smartsheet
components.description: Smartsheet API integration. SMARTSHEET_ENDPOINT is empty in production, so the integration is configured but inactive there.

authorization.note: Not present in docs/boundary_diagram.md and no ADR covers it. Requires disposition.
